- Southern_Blight: field-wide shot, no close-up of stem symptoms

**Decision:** The test image shows a large, tan-brown, dry stem canker that is extensive across the main stem. This matches Bacterial Canker and Wilt of tomato (caused by *Clavibacter michiganensis*), which causes characteristic external stem cankers with tan-brown corky tissue. The associated leaf yellowing/wilting is also consistent. None of the other classes showed this specific pattern of dry, extensive tan-brown stem cankers.
